premises.text: Conventional databases only store, organize, and look up data rather than understanding or predicting from it
premises.evidence_span: storing, organizing, and letting you look things up in your data

premises.text: A predictive database that SQL-familiar developers can query with a predict-style interface fills missing values and surfaces relationships
premises.evidence_span: a predictive database that lets you, if you know how to talk to a database

premises.text: The same learning works across application domains such as profiles, disease-symptom links, customer-product links, and survey/voting patterns
premises.evidence_span: It also works across application domains

value.text: Application builders get prediction and relationship understanding without hiring data scientists or doing the math themselves
value.evidence_span: doing these sorts of things without having to understand all the math

causal_links.evidence_span: make the actual database itself a lot smarter
if you can use SQL, you can use Veritable
